_comment: Tarot card photo captions per episode slug, rendered under the card on each episode page. scripts/fetch-episode-cards.py fills these from each Substack post's captioned figure and never overwrites an existing caption. ep1-3's Substack figures have no caption, so theirs are hand-entered here from the episode records in ~/.psyche/podcast/episodes/.

episode-001-what-kind-of-smoke-is.caption: Card, pulled in retrospect: Fumus / Smoke — The Wild Unknown Alchemy (Kim Krans).

episode-002-participant-not-consumer.caption: Card: The Hanged Man — Neon Tarot.

episode-003-shadow-capitalism.caption: Card: King of Pentacles (“the King of Guap, the Zaddy”) — Gen Z Tarot.

episode-004-animism-all-the-way-down.caption: Card: Five of Wands, reversed — the Eldritch Overload deck (Weird Works), a tech-magic deck.

episode-005-theres-no-waning-cycle.caption: Card: Ten of Swords (Magic Pantry) + Five of Wands (Crow deck).

episode-006-the-tension-is-the-point.caption: Card: The Empress — The Gay Marseille Tarot (The Word Witch).

episode-007-the-most-repressed-archetype.caption: Card: The Magician — Deviant Moon Tarot (Patrick Valenza).

episode-008-when-do-we-bare-our-teeth.caption: Card: Strength — Symdala Tarot (Jennifer Cooper Steidley). Pulled as a jumper.

episode-009-from-the-vault-you-cant.caption: Card pulled: Star Mother — “How can you mother yourself?” — from the Work Your Light Oracle (Rebecca Campbell).

episode-010-fighting-for-the-three.caption: Card: Knight of Swords — Tarot of the Vampires (Charles Harrington, illustrated by Craig Maher).

episode-011-a-race-car-in-the-red.caption: Card: Queen of Blues (Queen of Cups) — Rhythm and Soul Tarot (Stacy Williams-Ng), illustrated after Bessie Smith.

episode-012-with-each-death-i-become.caption: Card: Death — The Ghetto Tarot, Alice Smeets
